description: Ask cPanel to issue or renew the free AutoSSL certificate for a shared-hosting account — the fix for "my site says not secure" or a certificate that expired. Runs the same check cPanel runs nightly, so it also reports WHY a domain was skipped, which is usually DNS still pointing elsewhere. Read the account first with `impreza_api_call` on /hosting/{serviceId}. Shared hosting only; a VPS or dedicated server gets its certificates from the deploy agent instead.
name: impreza_hosting_autossl
